purpose: Additional display and numerical geometry check of V2-0045 and V2-0048, from the December exposure whose convention was independently checked in mapping_followup. No origin assignment or mutation of previous findings.
local_correlation: Seven-column raw aperture and native spectrum, each high-passed by a 31-pixel median filter. Record Pearson correlation for old and corrected arguments separately.
local_continuum_geometry: Median spatial profile across each candidate-excluded interval; parabolic interpolation of the highest spatial pixel and its neighbors, compared with the corrected trace polynomial.
display: 31-by-41 raw cutout around the corrected trace; raw, positive background-subtracted image, native spectrum, and outer-row median profile; old and corrected trace positions overlaid.
immutability: No writes to mapping_followup, triage_batch01, detector, catalog or disposition tables. All additional outputs stay in mapping_followup_additional.
